mapper.delete: DELETE FROM gf_accounting_snapshot WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM gf_app_user WHERE account_status=4) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gf_app_user WHERE gf_app_user.id=gf_accounting_snapshot.user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id,version,payload,operation_id FROM gf_accounting_snapshot WHERE user_id > #{userId} ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 100
SELECT user_id, version, payload, operation_id FROM gf_accounting_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gf_accounting_snapshot (user_id, version, payload, operation_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{version}, #{payload}, #{operationId})
